purpose: Cleaned runway reference data from the OurAirports source: one row per runway (grain: id), carrying the owning airport (airport_ref, airport_ident), physical dimensions (length_ft, width_ft), surface and status flags (lighted, closed), and low-end/high-end runway-end geometry (identifiers, coordinates, elevations, headings, displaced thresholds). It feeds airport and runway analytics and joins to airport dimension tables on airport_ref or airport_ident.
usage: Read one row per runway id; join to airports on airport_ref (numeric id) or airport_ident (code). Consumers should deliberately filter closed = false for active-runway analyses and expect roughly 22-28% null rates on runway-end coordinates, elevations, and headings, and about 88-90% nulls on displaced thresholds, since most runways simply lack those attributes. The surface column is uncontrolled free text with 239 spellings and must be normalized by the consumer if grouped on.
limitations: The cleanup does not normalize the 239 free-text surface values, does not impute the missing runway-end geometry (null rates 0.220911 to 0.276301 on coordinates and elevations, 0.884201 and 0.899907 on displaced thresholds), and retains a he_heading_degt max of 362.0 that exceeds the valid compass range. length_ft includes a min of 0.0, which may indicate unknown rather than zero-length runways; no row filtering was applied.
